senses.gloss: † धूश् धूश् (= धूष्, q. cf.), i. 10, Par. To make splendid.

धूष् धूष् (perhaps a dialectical form of धृष् for हृष्), i. 10, Par. To make splendid.
 --With the prep. उद् उद्, उद्धूषित, Having the hairs (of the body) standing on end (out of joy), embellished, Pañc. 190, 21.
 --With प्रोद् प्र-उद्, प्रोद्धूषित, Having the hairs standing on end (on account of chill), Pañc. 94, 4.
† धूस् धूस् (a dialectical form of धूष्, q. cf.), i. 10, Par. To make splendid.
धूसरत्व धूसर + त्व, n. Paleness, Lass. 72, 11 (see धूषरत्व).

धूसर धूसर, i. e. ध्वंस् + अर,
 I. adj., f. रा, Gray (like dust), Ragh. 5, 42.
 II. f. रा, A small shrub, Varāh. Bṛh. S. 76, 6.
 --Comp.
धूसरक धूसर + क, m. A proper name, Pañc. 214, 13.
